evidence.title: WATCH | Aston Martin raises the roof
evidence.body: [e002:f01] There are certain compromises you might expect when removing the roof from a supercar. [e002:f02] Aston Martin, however, has gone to considerable lengths to ensure its new Valhalla Spider makes as few concessions as possible. [e002:f03] Following the introduction of the mid-engined Valhalla Coupé earlier this year, the British marque has unveiled its open-top counterpart, which retains the same 794kW plug-in hybrid powertrain and electronically limited top speed of 350km/h. [e002:f04] More remarkably, that figure is achievable with or without the roof, making it the fastest open-cockpit Aston Martin yet. [e002:f05] The Spider shares its dramatic, low-slung proportions with the coupé, along with much of the advanced technology developed in collaboration with Aston Martin’s Formula 1 team. [e002:f06] The air intake behind the cockpit has been raised and reshaped to accommodate the Spider's open-top configuration. [e002:f07] In this case, Aston Martin has paid particular attention to keeping the car stable and its occupants comfortable. [e002:f08] To keep things reasonably civilised in the open cockpit, Aston Martin has developed a removable wind deflector that directs air over the occupants while maintaining airflow to the engine. [e002:f09] The distinctive air intake behind the cabin has also been raised by 35mm and reshaped to suit the Spider. [e002:f10] With the roof fitted, the system can generate more than 600kg of downforce, helping keep the Valhalla firmly planted at high speeds. [e002:f11] The arrangement allows the car to distribute power between its wheels as needed, improving traction and handling whether it’s negotiating a tight corner or accelerating out of one. [e002:f12] With a top speed of 350km/h, the Valhalla Spider is Aston Martin's fastest open-cockpit model. [e002:f13] Picture: The Spider also retains the coupé’s lightweight carbon-fibre structure, developed with input from Aston Martin’s Formula 1 engineering specialists. [e002:f14] The signature upward-opening doors remain but now feature frameless glass and revised mechanisms for smoother operation. [e002:f15] According to Aston Martin CEO Adrian Hallmark, the Spider builds on the advances introduced by the coupé. [e002:f16] But Aston Martin appears determined to ensure that removing the roof doesn’t mean sacrificing the qualities that make the Valhalla special.

evidence.title: Aston Martin launches Spider variant of Valhalla supercar
evidence.body: [e003:f01] As with the coupe, the Valhalla Spider is powered by a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 and three electric motors, for a total output of 1,079PS. [e003:f02] The Valhalla Spider is capable of achieving its 217mph top speed with the roof off, or when the optional carbon fibre hard top is fitted. [e003:f03] It is the fastest open-cockpit model in Aston Martin’s history. [e003:f04] A removable and stowable black fabric roof is standard-fit. [e003:f05] ADVERTISEMENT Aston Martin fitted a wind deflector to the top of the windscreen, to manage airflow over the open cockpit, ensuring performance is maximised with the roof off. [e003:f06] The car’s active aerodynamics and stability control calibrations have been revised, to account for the aerodynamic differences between the roof on and off configurations. [e003:f07] As standard, Spider models are fitted with the carbon fibre Touring Seat, which was designed to enhance comfort, and ease of entry and exit with the roof on. [e003:f08] ADVERTISEMENT Customers can select the coupe model’s seat at no cost. [e003:f09] Deliveries of the Aston Martin Valhalla Spider will begin in Q3 2027. [e003:f10] ADVERTISEMENT Adrian Hallmark, CEO at Aston Martin, said: “Valhalla Coupe broke so much new ground. [e003:f11] Our first production mid-engined supercar. [e003:f12] The first to feature our bespoke flat-plane crank V8 engine, and the first to use our all-new 8-speed Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT). [e003:f13] ADVERTISEMENT “It also pioneered a fresh design language and achieved a unique blend of exemplary on-road feel and engagement matched by extraordinary on-track capability. [e003:f14] “Valhalla Spider builds on those impressive ‘firsts’, preserving the aesthetic beauty and dynamic bandwidth of Valhalla Coupe while introducing the expanded opportunities for enjoyment and engagement that can only be found in an open-cockpit supercar. [e003:f15] “High speed or low speed. [e003:f16] Valhalla Spider ticks every box.” © Motor Trade News · Related Aston Martin to open Q London flagship dealership Porsche previews future supercar with Mission S concept Porsche celebrates 75 years in the UK Lamborghini Urus, Ferrari 296 among cars sold via Q3 Carwow auctions Porsche targets higher margins and lower volumes, 9,000 workforce reduction Bentley partners with Tutto Bene for event at Monterey Car Week McLaren reveals McL 6GT as first manual car since F1 Bentley marks Torcal debut with First Edition Bristol Cars returns with revived Fighter programme Caterham to exhibit at London International Motor Show 2027 Dick Lovett marks 60th anniversary with five one-off Ferraris Mazda discontinues 2.0-litre MX-5, adds trim levels to 1.5 variant Search Press Esc to close.

evidence.title: HRC渡辺康治社長が退任へ F1復帰を決断した功労者 後任は安田啓一副社長 画像1
evidence.body: [e004:f01] エイドリアン・ニューウェイ率いる開発陣が手掛けたシャシーについても「特別優れてはいない」と評価し、アストンマーティンF1が2027年に競争力を高めるためには、マシン全体の改善が必要だと訴えた。 [e004:f02] アストンマーティン・ホンダF1は今季、PUの出力不足やドライバビリティの問題に苦しんできた。 [e004:f03] 一方、夏に投入した大幅… 1時間前 アストンマーティン・ホンダF1 予選で最高速最下位から決勝では2位 アロンソ349.5km/h 2026年F1アメリカGPで、アストンマーティンF1にパワーユニット（PU）を供給するホンダが、ストレートスピードで意外な数字を残した。 [e004:f04] 予選ではフェルナンド・アロンソとランス・ストロールが最高速ランキングの下位2台に沈んだが、決勝ではアロンソが349.5km/hを記録し、全22台中2番手に浮上した。 [e004:f05] FIAが公表した公式スピードトラップデータによると、決勝で最速だったのはメルセデスのジョージ・ラッセルで349.6km/h。 [e004:f06] アロンソはわず… 18時間前 フェルナンド・アロンソ 下位ドライバー酷評に元F1ドライバーが反論「言い過ぎだ」 アストンマーティンF1のフェルナンド・アロンソが、2026年F1アメリカGP後にグリッド後方のドライバーたちを「レベルが非常に低い」と酷評したことに対し、元F1ドライバーのイバン・カペリが「言い過ぎだ」と反論した。 [e004:f07] アロンソは決勝1周目にウィリアムズのアレックス・アルボンと接触し、マシンに大きなダメージを負って16位でフィニッシュ。 [e004:f08] レース後には下位グループのドライバーの技量を厳しく批判したが、カペリは競争力の低いマシンを駆るドライバーが… 22時間前 アストンマーティンF1 メキシコGPのFP1でクロフォード起用 ストロールに代わり走行 アストンマーティン・ホンダF1は、2026年F1第20戦メキシコシティGPのフリー走行1回目（FP1）に、サードドライバーのジャック・クロフォードを起用することを発表した。 [e004:f09] クロフォードはランス・ストロールに代わってAMR26をドライブし、今季4回目の公式練習走行に臨む。 [e004:f10] 21歳のクロフォードは、2024年にアストンマーティンのドライバー育成プログラムに加入。 [e004:f11] 2026年はサードドライバーとして活動し、日本GP、オーストリアGP、ベルギーG… 2026年10月28日 05:26 通知を受け取る 最新ニュースをいち早くお届けします YouTube Shorts YouTubeで開く @F1Gate のチャンネル。

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e006:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e006:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e006:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e006:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e006:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e006:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e006:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e006:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e006:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e006:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: Telesat Lightspeed Needs 14 SpaceX Falcon 9 Launches
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Canada’s Telesat Bet Rides on 14 SpaceX Launches [2026] Daniel Roth Updated Oct 27, 2026 · 14 min read Canada wants a military satellite network it controls, and it just paid for one. [e001:f02] On August 4, 2026, Canada’s Defence Investment Agency awarded Telesat an initial contract worth roughly C$2.3 billion to expand its Telesat Lightspeed constellation. [e001:f03] Telesat’s own announcement says the 69 additional satellites will be “launched by SpaceX on already-secured Falcon 9 rockets.” That detail sits at the center of a story that Drive Tesla Canada and India’s have both framed as Canada’s push away from Starlink. [e001:f04] It is incomplete in another, because the launch chain still runs through SpaceX pads in California and Florida. [e001:f05] Add now Canada’s Telesat Lightspeed Contract: What Happened on August 4 The award came from Canada’s Defence Investment Agency under the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project, Polar, known as ESCP-P. [e001:f06] That lifts the planned Lightspeed constellation from 156 to 225 satellites, a jump of about 44 percent over the earlier plan. [e001:f07] He said the project provides “secure, resilient, and reliable connectivity in the Arctic and other high-latitude regions where they need it most.” He added that the government is “defending Canada’s sovereignty and security.” Both phrases come from the announcement coverage. [e001:f08] Item Confirmed figure Stated by Contract award date August 4, 2026 Canada’s Defence Investment Agency Initial contract value About C$2.3 billion Telesat and Canadian government coverage Program ESCP-P, LEO Military Ka-band Defence Investment Agency Constellation size 156 to 225 satellites (69 added) Telesat Builder of added satellites MDA Space, Montreal Telesat Contracted SpaceX launches 14 Falcon 9 launches Telesat Satellites per launch Up to 18 Telesat Launch sites SpaceX facilities in California and Florida Telesat Military service start 2028 Telesat Global service start First quarter of 2028 Telesat Read down the table and one pattern jumps out. [e001:f09] Each launch can carry up to 18 Telesat Lightspeed satellites. [e001:f10] Falcon 9 is the vehicle Telesat chose for that job. [e001:f11] We broke down its list pricing in our explainer on what a Falcon 9 launch costs . [e001:f12] One additional Falcon 9 launch still depends on completing a final launch agreement. [e001:f13] Launch Math: How 14 Falcon 9 Flights Map to 156 and 225 Satellites The numbers invite a quick calculation. [e001:f14] Scenario Satellites Flights at 18 per launch (rounded up) Against 14 contracted Original Lightspeed plan 156 9 5 flights of headroom Added satellites only 69 4 Fits in a small slice of capacity Expanded Lightspeed plan 225 13 1 flight of headroom All 14 launches at full load 252 14 27 satellites above the 225 plan What the arithmetic shows and what it does not On paper, 14 flights cover the expanded constellation with room to spare. [e001:f15] A launch seldom flies at its stated maximum, because mass, orbital plane targets and spare units all shape how many satellites go up at once. [e001:f16] California and Florida: Where Lightspeed Leaves the Ground The launches are planned from SpaceX facilities in California and Florida, and the campaign is scheduled to begin in 2026.

evidence.title: Watch: SpaceX launches 27 Starlink satellites on its 117th Falcon 9 mission of 2026
evidence.body: [e003:f01] BY ANKITA GARKOTI UPDATED 1 DAY AGO Image of SpaceX Falcon 9 as it launches 27 more Starlink satellites into orbit. (Representative Cover Image Source: SpaceX) SpaceX has sent 27 more Starlink satellites into orbit from California in the early morning of October 27, 2026. [e003:f02] The Falcon 9 lifted off from Pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base at 3:25 a.m. [e003:f03] EDT, and this marks the 117th Falcon 9 launch of 2026. [e003:f04] The satellites, listed as Starlink Group 15-16, were successfully placed in low Earth orbit. [e003:f05] This was booster B1082’s 21st Starlink mission and its 26th flight overall. [e003:f06] Falcon 9 launches 27 @Starlink satellites from California https:// — SpaceX (@SpaceX) October 27, 2026 The booster shut down its engines and separated from the upper stage about 2.5 minutes into the flight. [e003:f07] Touchdown came at 8 minutes and 23 seconds after liftoff, just seconds before the upper stage finished its first engine burn. [e003:f08] A few minutes later, the 27 satellites were released. [e003:f09] Watch Falcon 9 launch 27 @Starlink satellites to orbit from California https:// — SpaceX (@SpaceX) October 27, 2026 SpaceX plans to wind down Falcon 9 as Starship takes over SpaceX’s Starlink network consists of more than 11,000 active spacecraft. [e003:f10] On top of that, plans to retire Falcon 9 have begun. [e003:f11] Falcon 9 launches the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission to orbit from Florida https:// — SpaceX (@SpaceX) October 20, 2026 Commenting on this, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk wrote on X , “Once Starship is flying reliably several times per week, it makes sense to shift super scarce SpaceX engineering and production resources to Starship to get launch rate to several times per day, which means winding down Falcon.” SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket flies above the Pacific Ocean carrying a payload of 22 Starlink internet satellites into space after launching from Vandenberg Space Force Base on April 1, 2024. (Image Source: Getty Images/Mario Tama) SpaceX is getting ready for Starship Flights 15 and 16 SpaceX has been busy at its Texas facility. [e003:f12] Its first stage, Booster 22, fired all 33 Raptor engines in a full-duration static fire test at 8:22 a.m. [e003:f13] On the following day, the 171-foot Ship 42, the upper stage for Flight 15, was rolled out to the Massey Outpost for a single-engine static fire at 9:17 p.m. [e003:f14] Full duration 33-engine static fire for the Super Heavy booster preparing for Flight 15 https:// — SpaceX (@SpaceX) October 25, 2026 Elon Musk has announced that both the booster and the ship will be caught at the end of Flight 15. [e003:f15] Starship Flight 16: Ship 43's going to Pad 2, likely for some catch tests with the chopsticks. https:// https:// — NSF - (@NASASpaceflight) October 26, 2026 According to reports, Flight 16 would be the first Starship launch from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. [e003:f16] Commenting on Flight 16, Musk added, “The next big milestone would be to refly both the booster and the ship,” with a Flight 16 where “all parts of an orbital rocket are reflown.” He also hinted that Flight 15 is only about four to six weeks away, and that it “probably launches a little bit before Thanksgiving, is my guess.” More on Starlust Starbase bustles with activity as SpaceX prepares for next two Starship flights NASA reveals major details on SpaceX and Blue Origin lander plans ahead of Artemis III and IV。

evidence.title: Starlink Mobile launches in Brazil, bringing satellite coverage to 50 million customers
evidence.body: [e002:f01] According to an announcement from Starlink on Monday, the service is already live, with seven million phones connected to the satellite network and coverage extending across the entire country. [e002:f02] The service, called Vivo Satélite, automatically connects compatible smartphones to Starlink satellites when terrestrial coverage is unavailable, provided users are outdoors with a clear view of the sky. [e002:f03] Starlink says Brazil is its first nationwide satellite-to-mobile service, with 50 million eligible customers and seven million phones already connected. [e002:f04] Starlink Mobile is now live in Brazil with @vivobr! [e002:f05] 50M customers can use apps and messaging in cellular dead zones — with 7M phones already connected. [e002:f06] This is the first nationwide service to cover the entire country. [e002:f07] The next-gen service – Starlink Mobile V2 – will make sure all Brazilians have access to high-speed mobile internet, from small fishing villages deep in the rainforests to remote stretches of highways 🛰️📱 — Starlink (@Starlink) October 26, 2026 In Brazil, customers can use WhatsApp messaging and voice calls, SMS, iMessage, Google Maps and Apple Maps without a conventional cellular signal. [e002:f08] Vivo confirmed that consumer customers will receive 12 months of free access, while business customers will receive a three-month trial (via Terra ). [e002:f09] The launch comes as SpaceX continues expanding its direct-to-cell technology internationally, including a growing partnership with Rogers in Canada to bring satellite connectivity to more remote areas. [e002:f10] The Brazil launch also follows other international deployments, including Starlink Mobile’s partnership with VEON , which connected 11 million customers in less than a year. evidence.title: IIJエンジニアリング、Starlink・蓄電池・APなどを一体化した可搬型Wi-Fi基地「EG アクセスポッド」を12月に提供開始
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 月額制のレンタルサービスとして提供され、初期費用は11万円、月額費用は33万円～。 [e005:f02] 同製品は、Starlink、Wi-Fiアクセスポイント、蓄電池、ソーラーパネルなど、Wi-Fi環境の構築に必要な機器をカゴ台車型の筐体に搭載したもの。 [e005:f03] 最短10分でWi-Fiスポットを開設できるといい、屋外イベント会場をはじめ、災害時の避難所や通信設備のない建設現場などで活用できるとしている。 [e005:f04] 標準構成では、主回線に「Starlink Mini」、副回線にLTEモデムを採用した冗長構成となっている。 [e005:f05] 搭載しているWi-Fi 6対応アクセスポイントは、来場者用と運営用の2系統のSSIDを使用できる。 [e005:f06] 最大通信速度は下り最大200Mbpsで、同時接続台数は100台、無給電時の連続稼働時間は6時間以上。 [e005:f07] 必要な回線帯域や同時接続数、Wi-Fiの利用範囲、連続稼働時間などに応じて、搭載する通信機器や蓄電池のサイズを選択できる。 [e005:f08] また、同社が蓄電池の残量や回線品質などを遠隔から確認し、リモートでサポートする。

previous_updates.title: SpaceXの軌道データセンター構想、1GWで1700億ドル試算
previous_updates.summary: SpaceXがIPO投資家へ示した軌道データセンター構想について、地政学アナリストのPeter Zeihanは、1GW施設の組み立てにStarship約500回の打ち上げが必要と試算した。 宇宙では放射線遮蔽とGPUの排熱が課題となり、Wood Mackenzieは1GW施設の総費用を約1700億ドル、地上設備の約3倍と見積もった。 予測市場では1MWの軌道データセンターが2029年1月までに稼働する確率を14％と評価する。 SpaceXは地上側ではAnthropicと月額12億5000万ドルの計算能力契約を結んでいる。

evidence.body: [e001:f01] However, the Pentagon’s independent inspector general has refused to conduct such an investigation. [e001:f02] In a letter dated October 27, Pentagon Inspector General Maureen Platt stated that the senators’ questions regarding the system slowdowns and their consequences should be directed to the U.S. [e001:f03] “They are better positioned to address the issues raised in your letter and coordinate the Department’s responses,” Morin wrote. [e001:f04] One of the initiators of the investigation into the Starlink outages is Democrat Jean Shaheen. [e001:f05] She stated that she is concerned about the Inspector General’s refusal to investigate disruptions in the satellite communications that Ukraine is using to counter Russian aggression. [e001:f06] The Trump administration and SpaceX have provided conflicting explanations for the causes of these disruptions. [e001:f07] They weakened Ukraine’s defenses and unnecessarily endangered U.S. personnel in Ukraine,” the senator from New Hampshire noted. [e001:f09] Molly Halpern, a spokeswoman for the Pentagon’s Office of the Inspector General, stated that the office had carefully reviewed Congress’s request and determined that the issues raised should be addressed by the Department of Defense itself. [e001:f10] Communication Disruptions in Ukraine Disruptions in the operation of satellite terminals in Ukraine began on October 14, 2026. [e001:f11] The Trump administration and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk blamed each other for the Starlink restrictions in Ukraine. [e001:f12] The restrictions were lifted only on October 24. [e001:f13] Amid the Starlink scandal in Ukraine , Elon Musk once again called on Zelenskyy to step down . [e001:f14] Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that the situation with Starlink during the war in Ukraine has heightened Ottawa’s concerns about its dependence on foreign technology. [e001:f15] Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that the operational speed of Starlink and Starshell has not yet been restored, and the delivery of interceptor missiles to defend against Russian ballistic attacks is being delayed. evidence.title: 日経平均、AI・半導体主導で一時900円高 決算本格化前に上値探る
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 東京株式市場で日経平均株価が続伸し、一時900円超高となった。 [e007:f02] 米国市場のハイテク株高を受け、アドバンテストや東京エレクトロンなどAI・半導体関連株に買いが集中。 [e007:f03] 寄り付きは470円61銭高、前引けは798円73銭高の6万4067円10銭。 [e007:f04] 一方でTOPIXは小幅安となり、プライム銘柄の半数以上が値下がりするなど買いは一部に偏った。 [e007:f05] 29日には上げ幅が819円50銭に拡大した。 [e007:f06] 寄り付きは前営業日比470円61銭高の6万3738円98銭。 [e007:f07] 上げ幅は一時900円を超え、前場の終値は798円73銭高の6万4067円10銭だった。 [e007:f08] アドバンテスト（6857.T）、東京エレクトロン（8035.T）、ソフトバンクグループ（9984.T）の3銘柄で日経平均を450円程度押し上げた。 [e007:f09] 指数をけん引する一部の大型ハイテク株に物色が偏った格好で、市場関係者からは企業の中間決算発表が本格化するのを前に「決算内容を見極めたい」との声も出ている。 [e007:f10] 指標 水準 前日比 日経平均（前引け） 6万4067円10銭 +798円73銭 日経平均（寄り付き） 6万3738円98銭 +470円61銭 TOPIX（前引け） 3996.53 -0.84ポイント 注：数値は28日前場時点。 [e007:f11] AI開発企業の米アンソロピック（Anthropic）が新規株式公開（IPO）に踏み切る見通しが強まり、半導体関連への期待が高まった。 [e007:f12] 前日の米国市場でハイテク株が上昇したことで、東京市場でも関連銘柄に買いが先行した。 [e007:f13] 29日の取引では上げ幅がさらに拡大し、日経平均は前日比819円50銭高の6万4773円69銭まで上昇する場面があった。 [e007:f14] アドバンテストなど好決算銘柄への関心も強く、指数は高値圏での推移を試す展開となっている。 [e007:f15] 投資家の関心は、指数を押し上げてきた半導体株の上昇が決算発表を通過しても持続するかどうかに移りつつある。 [e007:f16] 中間決算の内容次第では、物色の裾野が広がるか、反動売りが出るかの分岐点となりそうだ。

evidence.title: 東証続伸、705円高 好決算で半導体銘柄に買い 前日の米株高も好材料
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 終値は前日比705円28銭高の6万4659円47銭で、約1週間ぶりに6万4000円を回復した。 [e008:f02] 好決算を発表した半導体関連銘柄を中心に買い注文が優勢となった。 [e008:f03] 東証株価指数（TOPIX）は11.57ポイント高の4003.28。 [e008:f04] 前日に半導体検査装置大手のアドバンテストが通期業績見通しの上方修正を発表し、買いを集めた。 [e008:f05] 好業績への期待からほかの人工知能（AI）や半導体関連銘柄も上昇し、相場を押し上げた。 [e008:f06] 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が市場の想定通り政策金利を据え置いたことも安心感につながった。 [e008:f07] 前日の米国株式市場はハイテク関連を中心に値上がりし、東京市場も流れを引き継いだ。 [e008:f08] Google検索で「産経ニュース」を優先表示。 [e008:f09] ワンクリックで簡単登録 ジャンル ： 経済 金融・財政。
